title: Nether_tool
description: A mod that add few tools that can create in nether. supported language: English Japanese
body:
This mod adds 20 tools and 1 item that can create by items in nether.
List of added items:
- Nether Stick
- Nether Rack Axe
- Nether Rack Hoe
- Nether Rack Pickaxe
- Nether Rack Shovel
- Nether Rack Sword
- Quartz Axe
- Quartz Hoe
- Quartz Pickaxe
- Quartz Shovel
- Quartz Sword
- Magma Block Axe
- Magma Block Hoe
- Magma Block Pickaxe
- Magma Block Shovel
- Magma Block Sword
- Black Stone Axe
- Black Stone Hoe
- Black Stone Pickaxe
- Black Stone Shovel
- Black Stone Sword
  Created by Mcreator
